name: stilingue-social-listening-mcp
title: Stilingue Social Listening
summary: Social listening MCP server by Stilingue (Blip): query public and panel social media data, audit panel setup and pull customer service (SAC) reports from your AI agent.
description: Stilingue Social Listening MCP Server gives AI agents secure, real-time access to Stilingue (a Blip company), a Brazilian social listening and customer care platform. Agents can search the public Radar base (posts, volume trends, sentiment, top influencers), query a customer's dedicated Warroom panels, list the panels and connected social pages the signed-in user can access, audit panel configuration (groups, themes, tags, automation rules) and, only after an explicit dry-run confirmation, edit collection descriptors. Beta tools report customer service (Smartcare/SAC) cases, SLA and response times. A Stilingue account is required; all data is scoped to the signed-in user's permissions.

useCases.name: Brand and topic monitoring
useCases.description: Search public social media conversations about a brand, product or topic using boolean queries, and retrieve posts, volume over time, breakdowns by channel, gender, device and sentiment, and the most relevant influencers (Radar).

useCases.name: Panel analytics
useCases.description: Query a customer's dedicated Warroom panel: publications, time-series trends, sentiment, interactions and top posts, with filters by channel, connected page, service type and date range.

useCases.name: Panel and connected page discovery
useCases.description: List the accounts and panels the signed-in user can access, with their permissions, and list connected proprietary social pages (Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn and others), flagging pages whose connection has expired.

useCases.name: Panel setup audit and improvement
useCases.description: Review a panel's configuration (collection groups, classification themes, tags, automation rules and collection limits), get a critical assessment, and create, rename or edit group and theme descriptors. Every change runs as a dry-run preview first and is applied only after explicit user confirmation.

useCases.name: Customer service (SAC) reporting (beta)
useCases.description: Report on Smartcare customer service cases: case volume, handling and response times, SLA, status history and backlog, and list service operators.

useCases.name: Executive summaries, one-pagers and presentations
useCases.description: Ground reports, slides and executive summaries in real social listening data instead of manual exports and screenshots.

useCases.name: Crisis response and campaign planning
useCases.description: Quickly assess volume, sentiment and the posts gaining the most traction around a crisis or a campaign topic, and use that evidence to guide a response or a creative direction.

useCases.name: Interactive Radar dashboard
useCases.description: In hosts that support MCP Apps, optionally open an interactive dashboard with the same Radar query after the text answer has been given.

stilingueoauth2.description: Sign in with a Stilingue account using the OAuth 2.1 authorization code flow with PKCE. Supports dynamic client registration.
